name: Default
shortDescription: Open source file system indexer and search engine that crawls storage into Elasticsearch and shows usage, file types and ages in a web dashboard.

alerts.message: Sign in right after deploy with the default user diskover and password darkdata: the first login forces you to set a new password, and until then anyone who reaches the domain can do it.

Nothing is indexed on first start. Put the files to scan in the /data volume, run a crawl from the diskover container terminal with: python3 /app/diskover/diskover.py -i diskover-data /data, then select the diskover-data index under Settings > Indices. Scheduled crawls go in /config/crontabs/abc and apply after a restart.
